summary: Global Mofy AI Ltd (issuer) files Form 6-K reporting a Share Exchange and Investment Agreement to acquire 2% of Star Touch (Beijing) Technology Co., Ltd. (Target). Issuer issued 2,500,000 Class A ordinary shares at US$0.8/share (aggregate US$2M) to Sellers in exchange for 2% equity in Target. Transaction is a privately negotiated stock-for-equity swap, structured as an exchange with shares unregistered, relying on Regulation S and Section 4(a)(2); resale registration on Form F-1/F-3 to be filed within two months. Closing subject to customary conditions including due diligence, regulatory filings, and no MAE. No premium stated. Watch for completion of due diligence and PRC regulatory approvals.
